column1: # Declared tooling for Elenchus, from the guidebook baseline stack (p1).
# risk=high is never installed by any automation flag. It means the tool can
# reach production, move money, or hold a credential. A person mounts those.
# capability gates scope: a row is dormant until felix doctor sees the surface.
# Bundled into the Claude Code binary, so it carries no marketplace and appears
# in no plugin list. Its skills are live in every session regardless; declaring
# it is what lets a route name one honestly.
